Alphabet’s Waymo Pulls Robotaxis Off Freeways After California Ban

Robotaxi services are continuing to operate on surface streets

By

Waymo, the autonomous-driving unit of Google parent Alphabet, temporarily restricted vehicle operations on U.S. freeways, the latest in a series of setbacks for the robotaxi industry.

The tech unicorn—one of the world’s most valuable private companies—made the move after California officials banned its self-driving cars from freeways in the state.
